To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the relative Wilson plot provides a rapid method for characterizing biomacromolecular samples and that this method can be used in a wide variety of applications.

(i) the relative Wilson plot provides a more rapid evaluation of the quality of biomacromolecules crystals and (ii) that the overall B-factor obtained from this plot provides a more reliable measure of the overall quality of the crystals than any other parameter.

the relative Wilson plot can be applied for the characterization of crystals and that the crystal quality strongly depends on the crystallization conditions and the region of the phase diagram from which a particular crystal was grown.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the crystal quality of biomacromolecules by neutron diffraction.
the characterization of biomacromolecules by neutron diffraction and the development of new methods for the characterization of biomolecular crystals.
the development of a more rapid and more accurate method for the evaluation of biomacramolecular crystal quality.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the relative Wilson plot is an appropriate method for the characterization of biomacromolecules crystals and that the relative Wilson B factor is the most appropriate parameter for describing the crystal quality.
the relative Wilson plot is more appropriate than Rmerge, I/sigmal, maximum resolution and mosaic for the characterization of biomacromolecule crystals.

the relative Wilson plot is a more rapid and more reliable method than the Rmerge, I/sigam(I), maximum resolution or mosaicity methods to characterize biomacromolecular samples for diffraction experiments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the relative Wilson plot is an efficient tool for rapid evaluation of biomolecular crystal quality and for the selection of crystals for further experiments.
the relative Wilson plot is a very useful tool for rapid evaluation of the crystal quality of biomacromolecules.
the relative Wilson plot provides more information on the quality of biomacromolecule crystals than other methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relative Wilson plot is an effective tool for the rapid evaluation of biomolecular crystal quality.
the relative Wilson plot can be used as a more rapid and reliable method of crystal quality assessment.

the relative Wilson plot is a very useful tool to characterize the overall crystal quality of protein crystals and it should be used routinely in conjunction with the more commonly used Rmerge, I/signal(I), mosaicity and resolution.
